trademark_clearance.note: The provisional StretchMLX product name is retired before public launch and the project is renamed OuterRAM, removing the known product-name dependency on Apple's MLX framework name. This rename-based approval is risk reduction, not a formal trademark clearance opinion for OuterRAM in every jurisdiction or class.

git_history_privacy.note: The new king-kruk/outerram repository was created from a clean baseline with no ancestry to the private development archive. Keep this pending until the complete imported tree, all reachable refs, commit identities and secret/privacy scans are verified and the final stage-2 PR gate is green.

repository_branch_protection.note: Before public release, enforce a GitHub ruleset/branch protection requiring pull requests and pr-gate on main, blocking force-push/deletion and avoiding routine bypass of required checks.

repository_security_features.note: Enable the public repository security controls documented in docs/PUBLICATION_CHECKLIST.md, including secret scanning/push protection, Dependabot security features and Private Vulnerability Reporting when available.

dependency_license_review.note: Exact tested runtime pins were reviewed with strict dependency/license inventories. Future validated release candidates repeat this audit through manual full validation.

model_distribution_policy.note: OuterRAM code releases do not bundle model weights; every advertised model requires separate revision-specific license review.

privacy_disclosure.note: Current local-first behavior, network-capable commands, diagnostics and future hosted-feature requirements are documented.

third_party_notices.note: Current directly integrated runtimes are independently installed; source revisions and reviewed licenses are documented and pinned.

full_release_validation.note: Before calling a release fully validated, manually run CI with full_validation=true on the exact intended release commit and retain Python, upstream-contract, macOS, package/legal and runtime-license evidence.

physical_apple_silicon_validation.note: Before publishing real Apple-Silicon inference/performance claims, qualify at least one supported model on physical hardware and retain exact model/revision/strategy/disk/TTFT/throughput/memory/swap/tool-roundtrip evidence.

patent_freedom_to_operate.note: Obtain qualified patent/FTO review before representing the project as patent-cleared or launching a material commercial product.
